name: Does the specific floor of an oceanfront condo impact its value?

mainEntity.name: Does the specific floor of an oceanfront condo impact its value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the specific floor of an oceanfront condo can significantly impact its value. Higher floors often command higher prices due to improved panoramic views, reduced noise, and increased privacy. However, ground-floor units with direct beach access or larger patios can also be highly desirable. The premium for higher floors is particularly noticeable in high-rise coastal areas throughout Miami-Dade and Broward counties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Higher floors generally command higher prices due to better views, less noise, and privacy, though ground-floor direct access units can also be valuable.
